title: Development test cases
description: Give only test_cases, or give exhausted: true and a non-blank reason when four valid new cases cannot be written without changing the confirmed test. Any other shortfall is an error.

exhausted.description: Must be true when declaring exhaustion; omit test_cases and include reason.

reason.description: Why fewer than four valid new cases remain without changing the confirmed test; required with exhausted and otherwise omitted.

test_cases.description: At least 4 new test cases of the failed test, each with values different from every other test case.

values.description: One value for every variable of the test, and for no other variable. Each item has either text or call.

call.description: A call to a value generator built into CAT, such as {"generator": "log_lines", "count": 18000} with whole-number parameters, whose output replaces {{name}}. CAT adds the seed and version. A generated value may appear only in the contents of workspace files.

expected_outcome.description: The result that a compliant reply gives for these values.
